root_cause.text: The mt7925 transmit path function mt7925_mac_write_txwi_80211() accessed IEEE 802.11 management action frame fields from the skb without validating that the frame was long enough, allowing out-of-bounds reads on short action frames.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `skb->len >= IEEE80211_MIN_ACTION_SIZE + 1` to the existing `ieee80211_is_action(fc)` check before reading `mgmt->u.action.category` and `mgmt->u.action.u.addba_req.action_code`, and both the CVE and commit message explicitly state this is to "avoid a possible oob access."
